entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Ha-Meem. (These are individual letters of the Arabic alphabet; Allah and His Messenger know their exact meanings.)
By the oath of that Luminous Book (i.e. the Qur'aan).
We have indeed sent it down in a blessed night; indeed, it is We Who warn.
Therein are distributed all the works of wisdom.
By a command from Us. Indeed, it is We Who send (Prophets).
Mercy from your Lord; indeed, only He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
He Who is the Lord of the heavens, and the earth and whatever is between them; (you will know this) if you have certainty.
No one is worthy of worship except Him, He gives life and causes death; (He is) your Lord and the Lord of your previous forefathers.
Rather, they (i.e. the disbelievers) are in doubt, playing.
So, you keep waiting for that day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke.
Which will smother the people; this is a painful punishment.
They will say on that day, 'O our Lord! Remove the punishment from us, we now accept faith.'
How can it be (a possibility) for them to accept advice? Whereas, a Messenger who speaks clearly has already come to them.
They then turned away from him and said, 'He is a madman, tutored (by Jinn)!'
We remove the punishment for some days; you will then do the same (i.e. you would disbelieve again).
(Remember) the Day when We will seize with the greatest seizure; indeed, We are to take revenge.
And We indeed tested the people of Fir'awn before them, and an honourable Messenger (Moosa) came to them.
(Who said) that 'Hand over the bondsmen of Allah to me; I am indeed a trustworthy Messenger to you.'
'And do not rebel against Allah; I bring to you a clear proof.'
(Said Moosa) 'And I take refuge in my Lord and your Lord, in this regard that you may stone me.'
'And if you do not believe in me, so keep apart from me.'
So, he supplicated to his Lord; that 'These are a criminal people.'
We commanded him, 'Take My bondsmen away at night, you will definitely be chased.'
'And leave the river opened as it is, at different places. Indeed, that army (of Fir'awn) will be drowned.'
How many gardens and water-springs they have left behind.
And crop-fields and nice houses.
And bounties wherein they were stress-free.
This is how We did; and We made another nation their heirs (to use and enjoy their goods).
So, the heavens and the earth did not cry over them, and they were not given respite.
And indeed, We rescued the Children of Israel from a disgraceful punishment.
From Fir'awn; he was indeed arrogant, amongst the transgressors.
And indeed, We knowingly chose them above the people of that time. (This is another favour upon the Children of Israel.)
And We gave them those signs in which there was a clear award.
Indeed, these people say.
'There is nothing except us dying once (only), and we will not be raised.'
'Therefore, bring back our (dead) forefathers, if you are truthful.'

Are they (i.e. the disbelievers of Makkah) better (in might), or the people of Tubba' (a king of Yemen) and those who were before them (i.e. before the people of Tubba'). We destroyed them (i.e. the previous disbelievers); they were indeed criminals.
And We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in amusement.
We did not create them except with the truth (i.e. genuine purpose), but most of them know not.
Indeed, the Day of decision is the appointed time for all of them.
The Day on which a friend will not benefit a friend at all, and nor will they be helped.
Except him upon whom Allah has mercy; indeed, only He is the Honourable, the Merciful.
Indeed, the tree of Zaqqoom.
It is the food of the sinners (i.e. the disbelievers).
Like molten copper; it boils in (their) bellies.
Like the boiling of sizzling hot water.
(The angels of Hell will be ordered) 'Seize him, take him by force, dragging (him) right to the Blazing Fire.'
'Then pour on his head the punishment of boiling water.'
(It will be said to him sarcastically) 'Taste! Yes, certainly! Only you are the most honourable, the dignified.'
'Indeed, this (punishment) is that in which you used to doubt.'
Indeed, the pious people are in a place of safety.
In Gardens and water-springs.
(They) will wear fine and thick silk, (and will be) facing each other.
This is how it is, and We have got them married to the maidens having pitch black and big, bright (gorgeous) eyes.
Therein they will ask for all kinds of fruits, in peace.
They will not taste death in it (i.e. in Paradise) except their former death, and Allah has saved them from the punishment of the Fire.
As bounty from your Lord; this is the great success.
So, We have made this Qur'aan easy in your language; that they may understand.
Therefore, you wait (O Beloved, for their destruction), they too are waiting (for your passing away).
